Definition: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which latter appears only in certain tenses); to arrange in an orderly manner, i.e. assign or dispose (to a certain position or lot):--addict, appoint, determine, ordain, set.
BiblicalUsage: The word is to arrange, to appoint, to set in order. As many as were ordained to eternal life believed; the powers that be are ordained of God; and the centurion says he is a man set under authority, with soldiers under him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's ordaining stands behind both the believer's faith and the ruler's power, and neither happens by chance.
